title: Blazon — Coat of Arms Studio
description: Design a coat of arms from real heraldry — divisions, ordinaries, charges — and it writes its own blazon as you work.
concept: A vector heraldry workbench. Pick a shield shape, divide the field (per pale, quarterly, gyronny, chequy, lozengy and ten more), lay an ordinary across it with a wavy, indented, engrailed or embattled edge, then charge it with eighteen hand-built devices from mullets to a lion's face. Every change rewrites the blazon underneath in proper heraldic English, and a tincture watchdog catches colour-on-colour before a herald would. Flip to engraver's hatching for the monochrome print convention, add helm, mantling and a motto ribbon, then export SVG or PNG, save to a local armory or share the whole design in a URL.
features: 14 field divisions plus 5 partition-line styles (wavy, indented, engrailed, embattled)
11 ordinaries, each placeable with styled edges, plus charges placed on the ordinary
18 procedurally drawn charges, 1-6 per shield with arrangement and scale control
Live blazon generator writing proper heraldic English for every design
Rule-of-tincture checker with a one-click correction
Engraver's hatching mode (dots for or, verticals for gules, horizontals for azure)
Helm, ducal crown or wreath crest, mantling and a curved motto ribbon
SVG and 2x PNG export, localStorage armory, and shareable URL-encoded designs

interaction.mouse: Paint tinctures from the top strip onto the selected slot; pick divisions, ordinaries and charges in the Design panel
interaction.click: Random rolls a fresh coat of arms; Presets cycles six worked examples; Save keeps it in the armory
interaction.touch: Panel slides over the shield on phones; tapping the shield dismisses it
interaction.keyboard: R random · H hatching · S save · P export PNG · D panel · ←/→ charge count
